title: 第106章 亲自复仇 下第105章 亲自复仇 上
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
林江月顿感不妙。
那只铜镜不是凡品，她与铁血金甲之间的心神联系竟出现了一丝滞涩，像是有什么东西正在切断她对虫群的掌控。
她当机立断，不再恋战，抬手便要召回铁血金甲，准备离开大殿，日后再寻机会。
“哪里跑？”石长捷带着一股穷追不舍的狠厉，摇晃铜镜，金光漫天穿过铁血金甲虫群，直扑而来。
金光扑面，气势如虹。
与此同时，那两柄双刀再次飞转，一前一后，转速极快。
林江月没有慌乱，她左手探入腰间，猛地抽出鬼幡，令永夜王在身前抵御双刀，自己则在身后将铁血金甲一点点收进灵兽袋。
“狭路相逢啊！石长老？”永夜王身后显出八只黑手，面色凶狠。
石长捷握着铜镜的手微微一顿。
眯起眼睛，盯着那道从鬼幡中走出的身影。
脸上的警惕忽然化作带着三分戏谑的笑意。
“是你？”他打量了着永夜王，“你怎么在她手里？”
“一代道宗，最后竟落在一个小丫头片子手里——可笑，可笑。”
他收起笑容，语气中带上一丝拉拢的意味，
“不如随了我，我还能给你留点名声。”
永夜王的脸色在听到“一代道宗”四个字时微微变了一变。
身形一晃，整个人如同融化的黑影般从原地消失，下一刻竟从幡中拎出一具通体漆黑的尸体来。
永夜王单手抓住黒尸的后颈，将它挡在自己身前。
“当初一战，是我轻敌，中了你后手一击，随后被伏困在幻阵。”永夜王的声音从黒尸身后传来，带着怒意。
“如今你没了肉身，又拿什么跟我斗？”石长捷在原地看着永夜王，脸上露出一种从容不迫的神态。

“斗？”永夜王轻轻笑了一声，摇了摇头，“你气血将尽，我为何要与你斗？”
“咳咳。老夫虽有重伤，但不至于死。”
永夜王沉默了片刻，忽然发出了一阵沙哑的笑声。
然后越来越大，越来越刺耳，最后变成一种毫不掩饰的嘲讽。
“你被人下了蛊，竟不自知，哈哈哈！”
他的笑声戛然而止，目光落在石长捷那张骤然凝固的脸上，“你当真以为，改修鬼道便能逆天转运？”
石长捷握着铜镜的手指微微收紧，阴沉地看着永夜王。
铜镜翻转，金光如瀑，将殿顶照得雪亮。
永夜王身形一沉，整个人贴着地面滑出三丈。
他左手一抖，黑尸在半空张开双臂，十指漆黑如铁，朝石长捷抓去。
石长捷不退反进。
他右手双指并拢，朝前一划，两柄飞刀脱手而出。
前刀穿透黒尸的胸口，从背后飞出，带出一线黑血；后刀紧随其后，在空中划出一道弧线，绕到黒尸脑后，一刀斩断了它的脖颈。
黒尸的头颅滚落在地，身体向前冲出两步。
永夜王没有停手。
他右脚一蹬地面，身体腾空而起，跃至半空。
右手五指张开，指尖涌出浓密的黑气，迅速凝成一只巨大的鬼爪，猛地向下一挥，朝石长捷的头顶拍落。
石长捷抬头看了一眼那只鬼爪，面色不变。
他左手举起铜镜，镜面朝上，体内灵力灌入其中。
金光从镜面中喷涌而出，汇聚成一道粗壮的光柱，正面迎上那只落下的鬼爪。

鬼爪与金光在半空中相撞。
content_en:
Lin Jiangyue suddenly felt bad.
That bronze mirror was not ordinary, and the mental connection between her and the Iron-Blooded Golden Armor was a little stagnant, as if something was cutting off her control over the insect swarm.
She made a decisive decision and stopped fighting. She raised her hand to recall the Iron-Blooded Golden Armor, preparing to leave the hall and look for opportunities in the future.
"Where to run?" Shi Changjie shook the bronze mirror with a fierce pursuit, and the golden light filled the sky through the swarm of iron-blooded golden beetles and rushed towards them.
The golden light hits his face, and his momentum is like a rainbow.
At the same time, the two double knives spun again, one behind the other, rotating extremely fast.
Lin Jiangyue did not panic. She reached into her waist with her left hand and suddenly pulled out the ghost flag. She asked Yongye King to resist the two swords in front of her, while she put the iron-blooded gold armor into the spirit beast bag little by little behind her.
"We meet on a narrow road! Elder Shi?" Eight black hands appeared behind King Yong Ye, with a fierce look on his face.
Shi Changjie's hand holding the bronze mirror paused slightly.
Narrowing his eyes, he stared at the figure walking out of the ghost flags.
The vigilance on his face suddenly turned into a half-joking smile.
"Is it you?" He looked at King Yongye, "Why are you in her hands?"
"A generation of Taoist sects ended up in the hands of a little girl - ridiculous, ridiculous."
He put away his smile, and there was a hint of coaxing in his tone.
"Why don't you just follow me, I can still give you some reputation."
King Yongye's expression changed slightly when he heard the words "Daozong of a Generation".
With a flicker of his body, the whole person disappeared from the place like a melting black shadow. The next moment, a body covered in pitch black was pulled out from the streamer.
The King of Eternal Night grabbed the black corpse's neck with one hand and blocked it in front of him.
"In the first battle, I underestimated the enemy. I was hit by your backhand, and then I was trapped in the illusion formation." The voice of King Yongye came from behind the black corpse, filled with anger.
"Now that you have no body, how can you fight with me?" Shi Changjie looked at King Yongye from the spot, with a calm expression on his face.
"Fight?" King Yongye laughed softly and shook his head, "You are about to run out of energy and blood, why should I fight with you?"
"Ahem. Although I am seriously injured, I will not die."
King Yongye was silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a burst of hoarse laughter.
Then it got louder and louder, more and more harsh, and finally turned into an unabashed mockery.
"You were bewitched and you didn't even know it, hahaha!"
His laughter stopped abruptly, and his eyes fell on Shi Changjie's face that suddenly solidified, "Do you really think that by changing to the ghost path, you will be able to reverse the destiny?"
Shi Changjie's fingers holding the bronze mirror tightened slightly, and he looked at King Yongye gloomily.
The bronze mirror turned over, and the golden light was like a waterfall, illuminating the top of the hall brightly.
King Yongye sank, and his whole body slid three feet away from the ground.
He shook his left hand, and the black corpse opened his arms in mid-air, with his fingers as black as iron, and grabbed Shi Changjie.
Shi Changjie did not retreat but advanced.
He put the fingers of his right hand together, swiped forward, and two flying knives came out.
The front knife penetrated the black corpse's chest, flew out from behind, and brought out a line of black blood; the back knife followed closely, drew an arc in the air, went around the back of the black corpse's head, and cut off its neck with one knife.
The head of the black corpse rolled to the ground, and his body rushed forward two steps.
The King of Eternal Night did not stop.
He kicked the ground with his right foot, and his body rose into the air, leaping into the air.
The five fingers of his right hand were spread out, and thick black energy surged out from the fingertips, quickly condensing into a huge ghost claw, and he swung downwards and slapped Shi Changjie on the top of his head.
Shi Changjie raised his head and glanced at the ghost claw, his expression unchanged.
He raised the bronze mirror with his left hand, facing upwards, and poured his spiritual energy into it.
Golden light spurted out from the mirror, converging into a thick beam of light, facing the falling ghost claw head-on.
Ghost claws and golden light collided in mid-air.
